purpose: Develop and demonstrate end-to-end catastrophe-loss modelling
headline_candidate: Test whether learned pre-event geospatial representations add transferable, calibrated vulnerability information beyond hazard intensity and conventional building attributes, then measure the effect on financial loss and portfolio tail risk.

tracks.geoai_vulnerability: H -> H+X -> H+X+Z_engineered -> H+X+Z_GeoAI under held-out geography/event
tracks.catastrophe_risk: hazard -> exposure -> vulnerability -> damage -> MDR -> loss -> event loss -> AAL/OEP/AEP
tracks.integration: hold hazard/exposure/event set fixed; replace conventional vulnerability with calibrated GeoAI vulnerability and compare portfolio risk

prohibited_headline_claims: Novelty from fitting standard fragility curves to the existing Turkiye survey
Novelty from applying XGBoost, Random Forest or CatBoost to Nepal or Turkiye damage
Novelty from host-to-target or leave-one-event-out evaluation alone
Novelty from adding geology, Vs30, fault distance or topography alone
Novelty from using a GNN architecture alone
Treating spatial_this_study as independent observed ground-truth damage
Treating Visual_interpretation Join_Count or unlabeled footprint subsets as an engineering damage-state target

requirements: Preferred: obtain and audit authorized CSB ground-survey access
Fallback: explicitly freeze small-N engineering target protocol using independent survey labels
Do not substitute This_study or Visual_interpretation merely to increase sample size
Classify every proposed X and Z feature as verified pre-event, hazard, post-event, target-derived or unknown
Exclude post-event and target-derived variables from primary vulnerability models
Do not choose an IM or shock using held-out model performance
Freeze primary supervised target and held-out geographic/event claim
Do not claim cross-earthquake transfer of learned spatial representation from one Turkiye/Syria sequence
Version prohibited leakage variables before viewing results

catastrophe_track_policy.integration_rule: same hazard, exposure, event set and consequence mapping for conventional-vs-GeoAI risk comparison

resume_condition: 1F design frozen in configs/geoai_experiment_1f.json. Before 2A: reviewed protocol, deterministic checked frozen encoder extraction, audited context separation, explicit model-fitting authorization. This milestone fits nothing.
